audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0] says 'Yorick out-trades you at level 1', but this entry's chart gives level 1 to Akshan and its own early block opens with 'Yorick concedes the range early'. The single why contradicts both.
audit.why: Yorick has no gap-closer and Last Rites requires him to be in auto range; Akshan has Avengerang at 850. The chart and the early block agree with the kits, so whys[0] is the outlier and I rewrote it rather than touch the chart.
audit.corrected: Akshan edges level 1 on range; Last Rites only functions if Yorick walks into Avengerang range.

audit.why: Lvl 2-3 poke, first-item lethality, Lvl 6 Comeuppance, and Yorick's Maiden-plus-swarm late. Four spikes, right order, right owners.

audit.whatIsWrong: Dark Procession is treated purely as a trap — 'box you in', 'trap you against terrain' — with no mention that the wall is DESTRUCTIBLE, and no mention of the interaction that matters most here: it creates terrain, and Heroic Swing grapples into terrain. His cage is an anchor. Mourning Mist is also described as slow-plus-mark only, when it also reduces armour, and Last Rites is never identified as a heal or an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Riot's text for Dark Procession: 'summons a DESTRUCTIBLE wall at target location that will block enemy movement', 600 range, 20/18/16/14/12s. Riot's text for Heroic Swing: 'fires a grappling hook into terrain then swings around it.' Riot's text for Mourning Mist: 'reduces armor, damages, slows and marks enemies', 700 range, 12/11/10/9/8s. Riot's text for Last Rites: 'deals bonus damage on his next attack and heals himself', 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s. An Akshan boxed in by Dark Procession who does not know he can grapple the wall itself simply dies inside it.
audit.corrected: Dark Procession is destructible and it is terrain — Heroic Swing can hook it and arc you out. Mourning Mist shreds armour as well as slowing and marking. Last Rites heals off a 6s auto-attack reset.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mourning Mist and Dark Procession are each referenced four or five times with no cooldowns.
audit.why: Mourning Mist is 12s at rank 1 and Dark Procession 20s. Those are the two windows in which a Yorick with no dash cannot touch a ranged champion, and naming them turns 'bait his E' into a countdown.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds call despite Last Rites healing on a cooldown that reaches 4s.
audit.why: Last Rites heals him on every use, and against a lethality champion trying to hold him below an execute threshold that sustain is the reason the burst does not close. Anti-heal is the buy and it was never named.

edits.before: Yorick out-trades you at level 1 — his Q Last Rites with base juggernaut stats and early graves beats your lone passive shot before your poke fully comes online.
edits.after: You edge level 1 on range alone — Last Rites (Q) heals him off a 6s auto-attack reset, but he has to walk into Avengerang range to use it on you at all.

edits.before: Bait his E Mourning Mist, then use a Heroic Swing arc off the wall to dodge the slow, kite the ghoul swarm, and chip him
edits.after: Grapple his Dark Procession wall itself — it is terrain, so the cage he built doubles as your Heroic Swing anchor out

edits.before: Land E Mourning Mist to slow you and mark you, then send the ghoul swarm and Maiden to collapse before you swing out
edits.after: Land Mourning Mist (E) to shred your armour, slow and mark you, then collapse with the ghoul swarm and Maiden

edits.before: Box you in with the W Dark Procession ring-wall so the ghouls and his autos grind you down
edits.after: Box you in with Dark Procession (W) — 20s, 600 range — and let the ghouls grind you down

edits.before: Yorick's window: Maiden, a full ghoul swarm, and his W ring-wall to trap you against terrain zone you off the wave and out-split you — you cannot 1v1 him in the side lane.
edits.after: Yorick's window: Maiden and a full ghoul swarm out-grind you, and Dark Procession boxes you in — but that wall is destructible AND it is terrain, so Heroic Swing can hook it to leave.

edits.before: Yorick concedes the range early — he has no gap-closer, so your Q Avengerang and passive double-shot chip him for free while he tries to last-hit and stack graves for ghouls. The catch is his E Mourning Mist: it slows you hard and marks you for the ghouls to chase, and if it lands while you're committed he pulls you onto Maiden and the swarm. Poke from max Q range, cancel the second passive shot for the move speed when you need to disengage, and never sit in his E while you're mid-swing.
edits.after: Yorick concedes the range early — he has no gap-closer, so your Q Avengerang and passive double-shot chip him for free while he stacks graves for ghouls. Two catches. Mourning Mist (E, 700 range, 12s) does more than slow: it SHREDS your armour and marks you for the ghouls to chase. And Last Rites (Q) heals him off a 6s auto-attack reset, so his wind-up is your cue to step off, not the ghouls. Poke from max Q range, cancel the second passive shot for move speed when you disengage, and never sit in his E mid-swing.

edits.before: Once Yorick has Maiden, a first juggernaut item, and a full ghoul swarm, the lane flips — he out-grinds your lethality burst and his W Dark Procession ring-wall can trap you against terrain while the ghouls chew through you. You cannot 1v1 him in the side lane: he zones you off the wave and out-splits you. Your job is to have already turned the early-to-mid edge into kills and map pressure with your camo W roams, then group and let your R and range matter in teamfights instead of dueling him on the side.
edits.after: Once Yorick has Maiden, a first juggernaut item and a full ghoul swarm, the lane flips — he out-grinds your lethality burst and Dark Procession boxes you in while the ghouls chew through you. That cage has two answers: it is destructible, and it is terrain, so Heroic Swing grapples the wall itself and arcs you straight out. Even so, don't 1v1 him on the side. Turn the early-to-mid edge into kills and camo W roams, then group where your R and range matter.

edits.before: Maiden plus his first juggernaut item and a full ghoul swarm out-grind your lethality burst and reclaim the lane from you.
edits.after: Maiden, a juggernaut item and full ghouls out-grind you — and Last Rites heals every 4s at rank 5, so bring Grievous Wounds.

edits.before: He hard-scales: Maiden, full ghouls, and the W ring-wall trap zone you off the wave and out-split you — group and avoid the side-lane duel.
edits.after: He hard-scales: Maiden and full ghouls out-grind you and Dark Procession zones the wave — group and avoid the side-lane duel entirely.

notes: The best fix here is the same shape as the Trundle pillar: Dark Procession creates terrain, and Heroic Swing grapples INTO terrain, so the wall Yorick builds to trap Akshan is also Akshan's anchor out of it. The entry described the wall only as a cage, four times, and never mentioned that it is destructible either — so a player reading this page had no answer to the single ability that kills them in a side lane. Also added Mourning Mist's armour shred (the entry had slow and mark only), Last Rites as a healing auto-attack reset with the matching Grievous Wounds buy, and cooldowns for both. Separately, whys[0] claimed Yorick out-trades level 1 while the chart and the early block both give that stage to Akshan; I rewrote the why to match, since a melee champion with no gap-closer does not out-trade an 850-range boomerang.
